Class ExceptionDepthComparator

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.ExceptionDepthComparator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparator<Class<? extends Throwable>>
public class ExceptionDepthComparator extends Object implements Comparator<Class<? extends Throwable>>
能够根据从抛出异常类型开始的深度对异常进行排序的 Comparator。
Since:
3.0.3
Author:
Juergen Hoeller，Arjen Poutsma
